step_4_what_is_adjudicable.finding: The leaf is a labeling/annotation map, not a damage number. Two documented facts inside the permitted tree bear on whether it belongs on the combat readout at all:
step_4_what_is_adjudicable.a: data/worklists/p5-ux-task.md item 5 and data/worklists/p7-validation-task.md items 5-6 define P4 'trust labels' as a designed feature of the readout: every damage/heal row carries a certainty value (exact | estimate | boundary) plus a UI chip. A per-row {disposition, view_tag} map on /combat is exactly that contract's data shape - disposition = the certainty value, view_tag = the chip/view grouping.
step_4_what_is_adjudicable.b: docs/math-foundations.md Section 5 states the governing rule that no family may be presented unlabeled: 'APPROX = documented approximation (never silently presented as exact)'. An unlabeled readout (the old <absent> state) is the state that rule argues against.
step_4_what_is_adjudicable.c: Because the leaf carries no numeric magnitude, its addition cannot move any damage total. It is consistent with a labels-only change under the golden-gate semantics in CLAUDE.md ('a pure refactor must show zero diffs'), where the only diff is a new non-numeric leaf.

sources_quoted.quote: Trust labels UI (P4): the breakdown/ability rows render a certainty chip next to each damage/heal number: EXACT (fully sourced formula, no options), ESTIMATE (uses a defaulted player-controlled option), BOUNDARY (documented non-computed mechanic). The chip reads a new backend field 'certainty' on each ability row

GET /api/certainty?champion= -> {"champion": "...", "slots": {"Q": {"certainty": "exact|estimate|boundary", "reason": "..."}}} - derive per ability: EXACT when every damaging/heal row is a sourced formula with no player-controlled default (no options); ESTIMATE when the module uses a defaulted option (stacks/procs/uptime) or a documented approximation ...; BOUNDARY when a documented non-computed mechanic exists
Legend: EXACT = instantiates the identity exactly under the deterministic model; APPROX = documented approximation (never silently presented as exact).

`L` = eligible legendary items (116 in the current cache; the public coverage receipt reports the role-scoped subset ...); ... `|L| = 116`, so a 5-slot build has C(116, 5) ~ 1.60 x 10^8 subsets (x7 boot choices ~ 1.12 x 10^9 loadouts)
